source_licence_note: Official/primary public Environment Agency/Defra, Ordnance Survey, EPSG and UK National Data Library documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m current
official_sources.finding: ~99% England coverage, 1m GeoTIFF tiles, metres/ODN, OSTN15, survey inputs ±15cm RMSE; metadata indexes expose contributing surveys.

official_sources.title: National LIDAR Programme
official_sources.finding: National programme covers England at 1m; survey blocks and products include point cloud, DSM and ground-filtered DTM with tile-specific index metadata.

official_sources.title: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
official_sources.finding: Time-stamped DTM offers 25cm/50cm/1m/2m historical survey rasters, metres/ODN, ±15cm RMSE, and per-location survey date/resolution/transformation/geoid provenance.

official_sources.title: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
official_sources.finding: Independent ground-truth points are ±3cm RMSE; LIDAR surveys must pass <±15cm RMSE plus standard-deviation/random-error QC.

official_sources.title: Survey Data Catalogue vertical accuracy FAQ
official_sources.finding: EA specification states absolute height RMSE <±15cm and expected relative/random height error no more than ±5cm.

official_sources.title: LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
official_sources.finding: Point cloud is the upstream 3D source for EA timestamped raster models and retains ground/surface-object classifications; matching raster/point-cloud availability must be verified.

official_sources.title: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
official_sources.finding: DSM time-stamped tiles include surface objects, have 25cm–2m resolutions, metres/ODN and ±15cm RMSE; they are not interchangeable with bare-earth DTM.

official_sources.title: LIDAR Composite DSM 1m
official_sources.finding: Current 1m DSM includes buildings/vegetation and reports metres/ODN, OSTN15 and ±15cm survey RMSE; reject for bare-earth terrain extrema.

official_sources.title: LIDAR Composite First Return DSM 1m
official_sources.finding: First-return DSM includes surface objects and uses feathering across overlaps; its semantic surface differs from terrain DTM.

official_sources.title: LIDAR Composite DTM 2m
official_sources.finding: 2m composite DTM is public ODN/OSTN15 elevation with ±15cm survey RMSE; lower spatial resolution than 1m and should be fallback only.

official_sources.title: LIDAR Composite DTM 10m
official_sources.finding: 10m composite is a single resampled raster, metres/ODN and ±15cm input-survey RMSE; unsuitable as preferred parcel-scale extrema when 1m/native data exists.

official_sources.title: LIDAR mapping collection
official_sources.finding: National Data Library identifies EA 1m DTM as the accurate elevation model covering approximately 99% of England and downloadable as OS-grid GeoTIFF tiles.

official_sources.title: Survey metadata GeoPackage transition FAQ
official_sources.finding: Survey downloads now include spatial metadata index GeoPackages describing raster spatial location and temporal extent; index schema belongs in provenance.

official_sources.title: OSGM15 accuracy
official_sources.finding: OSGM15 standard error for Great Britain height datum is 0.008m; this model error excludes GNSS heighting errors.

official_sources.title: OS coordinate transformations
official_sources.finding: OSTN15/OSGM15 link ETRS89 GNSS positions to OSGB36 National Grid and mean-sea-level-based ODN heights.

official_sources.title: OS coordinate tools and developer resources
official_sources.finding: Official full OSGM15/OSTN15 grids, developer packs and test samples are available; reduced-density Lite transforms have lower accuracy and must not replace full terminal transform.

official_sources.title: EPSG ODN height 5701
official_sources.finding: EPSG 5701 defines ODN height as the vertical CRS used for Newlyn heights.

official_sources.title: EPSG ETRS89 to ODN height (2)
official_sources.finding: EPSG operation 7711 uses OSGM15, reports 0.008m operation accuracy and supersedes the OSGM02-based transformation.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 5 overview
official_sources.finding: OS Terrain 5 is 5m-post DTM; published RMSE is 1.5m urban/major routes and 2.5m rural or mountain/moorland, useful as a coarser independent benchmark.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 5 source data
official_sources.finding: OS Terrain source heights are above Newlyn Datum with geographic-class accuracy requirements; surface modelling and water handling can differ from EA LiDAR.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 50 overview
official_sources.finding: OS Terrain 50 is open 50m-post DTM with 4m RMSE, suitable only for coarse sanity checks, never parcel terminal extrema.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 50 documentation/access
official_sources.finding: OS Terrain 50 is OpenData, free to download, annual, and covers Great Britain; useful as public fallback/cross-check evidence.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 50 source data
official_sources.finding: Terrain 50 grid/contours are interpolated from a source TIN; most areas use Newlyn height, while some offshore islands use local datums.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 50 grid data
official_sources.finding: Terrain 50 grid values represent pixel centres at 50m spacing and GML carries vertical reference metadata; pixel-centre semantics must remain explicit.

official_sources.title: OS Net GNSS FAQ
official_sources.finding: OS states OSGM15 is 8mm rms for mainland Britain; orthometric height precision also depends on GNSS observations and should not be conflated with model-only accuracy.

official_sources.title: OS coordinate transformation formats
official_sources.finding: National Grid coordinate format uses metres Easting/Northing plus optional ODN height; units/reference must remain serialized.

accuracy_semantics.ea_lidar_relative_random_error: ±0.05 m expected relative/random error per EA FAQ
accuracy_semantics.osgm15_gb_model_standard_error: 0.008 m model-only standard error; excludes source survey/GNSS errors
